_source: Titles and descriptions copied from the AIO Research Training System (app/app.js MODULE_DESCS and app/modules.json) on 14 November 2026. 'available' follows app/site-config.js of the learning system on that date (Modules 1, 4, 5.1 and 5.2).

modules.label: Overview
modules.title: AIO Research Training Program: Overview
modules.summary: How the program is structured, the module map, and suggested learning pathways.

modules.label: Module 1
modules.title: What Is the Australian Internet Observatory?
modules.summary: What the Australian Internet Observatory is, what it offers researchers, and what it is not.

modules.label: Module 2
modules.title: What Questions Should We Answer Before Working with Digital Media Data?
modules.summary: Framing research questions and understanding what digital media data can and cannot answer.

modules.label: Module 3
modules.title: Why Can't We Just Collect It All?
modules.summary: The main ways of collecting digital media data, from user-centric to platform-centric methods.

modules.label: Module 4
modules.title: Working with Participants to Collect Data
modules.summary: Data donation as a participant-centred method: recruitment, consent, and study design.

modules.label: Module 5.1
modules.title: Collecting Data Using Data Download Packages
modules.summary: Data Download Packages (DDPs): what they contain, how to request them, and how to process them.

modules.label: Module 5.2
modules.title: Working with DDPs on the AIO Platform
modules.summary: Setting up and running a DDP study on the AIO platform, step by step.

modules.label: Module 6
modules.title: Ethics for Working with Digital Media Data
modules.summary: Ethics for digital media research: consent, privacy, de-identification, and ethics applications.

modules.label: Module 7
modules.title: Working with Platform-Centric Data
modules.summary: Platform-centric data: APIs, dashboards such as AIReD, and their limitations.

modules.label: Module 8
modules.title: Combining Data Donation with Traditional Methods
modules.summary: Combining data donation with interviews, surveys, and other traditional methods.
